title: Juicy American Strawberry Cobbler
description: A salty and juicy American dessert featuring strawberries and a keto-friendly twist, perfect for a lazy Sunday afternoon. This recipe combines the sweetness of strawberries with a crunchy bhuna-inspired topping.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, mix together the sliced strawberries and granulated sweetener.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the almond flour, melted butter, eggs, vanilla extract, bhuna spice mix, and salt.
Add the dry ingredients to the strawberry mixture and stir until just combined.
Pour the mixture into a 9x9 inch baking dish.
Bake for 40 minutes or until the topping is golden brown and the fruit is bubbly.
Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 minutes before serving.
